text:
Items before: sushi rolls (~8 pieces plus a spring roll), Greek-style salad with feta, grilled cheese/tomato sandwich, tea, orange juice, fruit salad, coconut cake slice.

After: sushi plate is clean, so the sushi and spring roll were eaten. The salad bowl is empty. The sandwich plate has crumbs only. The juice glass is empty and the fruit bowl is empty apart from some residue. The cake is mostly uneaten, with about one third left. The tea is gone. The soy sauce and wasabi cups are partly used.

Estimated energy and mass of what was eaten:
- Sushi, 8 pieces: about 350 kcal, 250 g
- Spring roll: about 100 kcal, 80 g
- Salad with feta: about 150 kcal, 200 g
- Grilled sandwich: about 300 kcal, 130 g
- Orange juice: about 110 kcal, 250 g
- Fruit salad: about 80 kcal, 170 g
- Cake, about 60% eaten: of a ~300 kcal, 120 g slice, about 180 kcal and 70 g
- Tea and soy sauce: about 5 kcal, 250 g

That totals about 1275 kcal and 1400 g.
